desc:
# Agent Python Tools

- repo: facebookresearch/meta-agents-research-environments
- repo_uri: https://github.com/facebookresearch/meta-agents-research-environments

## File: facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-environments/are/simulation/tests/cli/test_report_stats.py

Prompts

```
['calculate comprehensive benchmark statistics including per-capability success rates and global macro micro aggregates from a polars DataFrame', 'combine multiple MultiScenarioValidationResult objects into a single polars DataFrame with metadata columns for phase and config', 'generate a formatted GAIA2 validation report with per-capability and global summary statistics for a given model and provider', 'generate a structured JSON statistics report with metadata, per-capability stats, and run configurations from a polars DataFrame', 'convert a polars DataFrame of scenario results into HuggingFace dataset rows with trace file data loaded from export paths']
```

Usage

```
{'calculate_statistics': 'calculate comprehensive benchmark statistics including per-capability success rates and global macro micro aggregates from a polars DataFrame', 'combine_results_to_dataframe': 'combine multiple MultiScenarioValidationResult objects into a single polars DataFrame with metadata columns for phase and config', 'generate_validation_report': 'generate a formatted GAIA2 validation report with per-capability and global summary statistics for a given model and provider', 'generate_json_stats_report': 'generate a structured JSON statistics report with metadata, per-capability stats, and run configurations from a polars DataFrame', 'build_trace_rows_polars': 'convert a polars DataFrame of scenario results into HuggingFace dataset rows with trace file data loaded from export paths'}
```
name: facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-environments/are/simulation/tests/cli/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.calculate_statistics: calculate comprehensive benchmark statistics including per-capability success rates and global macro micro aggregates from a polars DataFrame
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.combine_results_to_dataframe: combine multiple MultiScenarioValidationResult objects into a single polars DataFrame with metadata columns for phase and config
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.generate_validation_report: generate a formatted GAIA2 validation report with per-capability and global summary statistics for a given model and provider
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.generate_json_stats_report: generate a structured JSON statistics report with metadata, per-capability stats, and run configurations from a polars DataFrame
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.build_trace_rows_polars: convert a polars DataFrame of scenario results into HuggingFace dataset rows with trace file data loaded from export paths
